items.description: High-performance message queue server implementing AMQP 0-9-1 and MQTT protocols, built with Crystal for exceptional throughput and minimal resource usage.

items.title: Apache Qpid (⭐70)
items.description: AMQP-compliant messaging tool with multi-language support for enterprise-grade message delivery.

items.title: Message Broker

items.description: Robotic Process Automation (RPA) solutions are software tools that automate repetitive, rule-based tasks within business processes. RPA bots can perform tasks such as data entry, data extraction, and data processing with accuracy and speed, freeing up human workers to focus on more complex tasks.

items.title: Robot Framework (⭐11k)
items.description: An open-source automation framework with human-friendly keyword syntax that enables both technical and non-technical users to create test scripts and automate business processes cost-effectively, supporting web, API, mobile, and database automation through extensive libraries and integrations.

items.title: TagUI (⭐6.3k)
items.description: An open-source RPA tool that democratizes automation through natural language scripting in 20+ human languages, enabling non-programmers to automate web, desktop, and data tasks while integrating AI/ML capabilities via Python and R for intelligent process automation.

items.title: OpenRPA (⭐3k)
items.description: Enterprise-grade, open-source robotic process automation suite.

items.title: Robotic Process Automation

items.description: Schema registries provide a central repository for managing and validating schemas for message and event data (such as Avro, JSON Schema, and Protobuf). They enforce compatibility rules as schemas evolve, enabling producers and consumers to exchange data safely in event-driven architectures.

items.title: Confluent Schema Registry (⭐2.4k)
items.description: Widely used registry for Kafka, providing a RESTful interface and compatibility checks for Avro, JSON Schema, and Protobuf schemas.

items.title: Apicurio Registry (⭐902)
items.description: Open-source registry for API designs and schemas, supporting Avro, Protobuf, JSON Schema, OpenAPI, and AsyncAPI artifacts with configurable compatibility rules.

items.title: Karapace (⭐625)
items.description: Open-source, drop-in replacement for Confluent Schema Registry and the Kafka REST API.

items.title: Schema Registry

items.description: Self-service and citizen integrator tools are designed to enable non-technical users to build integrations without the need for extensive programming knowledge. These tools typically feature drag-and-drop interfaces and pre-built connectors for popular applications and services.

items.title: n8n (⭐200k)
items.description: Open-source workflow automation tool with 400+ connectors, giving you full control over your data and integrations.

items.title: Huginn (⭐49k)
items.description: Self-hosted system for building agents that monitor services and act on your behalf, like a hackable version of IFTTT.

items.title: Activepieces (⭐23k)
items.description: Open-source, self-hostable automation platform with a no-code visual builder and hundreds of connectors ("pieces"), positioned as a Zapier alternative.

items.title: Node-RED (⭐23k)
items.description: Low-code, flow-based programming tool for wiring together hardware devices, APIs, and online services through a browser-based visual editor.

items.title: Automatisch (⭐13k)
items.description: Open-source business automation tool that connects popular services without sharing your data with third parties.

items.title: Pipedream (⭐11k)
items.description: Developer-centric integration platform that combines thousands of prebuilt triggers and actions with code-level control in Node.js, Python, Go, and Bash.

items.title: Self-Service Integration

items.description: Stream processing frameworks and engines transform, enrich, join, and aggregate continuous streams of events in real time. They complement message brokers by adding stateful computation — windowing, exactly-once processing, and event-time semantics — on top of data in motion.

items.title: Apache Spark (⭐43k)
items.description: Unified analytics engine whose Structured Streaming API provides scalable, fault-tolerant stream processing on the Spark SQL engine.

items.title: Apache Flink (⭐26k)
items.description: Distributed stream processing framework with stateful computations, exactly-once semantics, and event-time processing at scale.

items.title: RisingWave (⭐9.2k)
items.description: Postgres-compatible streaming database for incremental, real-time materialized views over event streams.

items.title: Redpanda Connect (⭐8.7k)
items.description: Declarative stream processor and connector toolkit (formerly Benthos) for transforming and routing data between systems.

items.title: Apache Beam (⭐8.6k)
items.description: Unified programming model for batch and streaming pipelines, portable across runners such as Flink, Spark, and Google Cloud Dataflow.

items.title: Arroyo (⭐4.9k)
items.description: Rust-native stream processing engine that lets users build real-time pipelines with SQL, designed for serverless operation.

items.title: Numaflow (⭐2.8k)
items.description: Kubernetes-native, serverless platform for massively parallel stream and data processing, with exactly-once semantics and language-agnostic user code.

items.title: Bytewax (⭐2k)
items.description: Python stream processing framework built on Timely Dataflow, combining Python's ecosystem with Rust performance.

items.title: ksqlDB (⭐314)
items.description: Database purpose-built for stream processing applications on Kafka, queried with SQL.

items.title: Stream Processing

items.description: Tools for sending, receiving, and operating webhooks reliably at scale — covering delivery retries, signing and verification, fan-out, event logs, and replay.

items.title: Svix (⭐3.3k)
items.description: Webhook sending service with an open-source server, handling signing, retries, and endpoint management for webhook providers.

items.title: Convoy (⭐2.8k)
items.description: Open-source webhooks gateway for sending and receiving webhooks with retries, rate limiting, and a management dashboard.

items.description: Software tools that enable the design, execution, and monitoring of complex workflows or business processes. Workflow engines provide a way to automate and streamline business processes, while orchestration engines help to manage the interactions between different systems or services.

items.title: Apache Airflow (⭐46k)
items.description: Platform for programmatically creating, scheduling, and monitoring workflows, ideal for managing complex data pipelines.

items.title: Conductor (⭐32k)
items.description: Durable workflow orchestration engine originally built at Netflix, now maintained by the community after the original repository was archived.

items.title: Kestra (⭐27k)
items.description: Event-driven declarative orchestrator with workflows defined in YAML and hundreds of plugins for data and infrastructure automation.

items.title: Prefect (⭐23k)
items.description: Modern, developer-friendly orchestration tool optimized for data pipelines and complex workflows.

items.title: Temporal (⭐22k)
items.description: Open-source workflow-as-code platform designed for building reliable, scalable, and fault-tolerant applications.

items.title: Windmill (⭐17k)
items.description: Open-source developer platform that turns scripts in Python, TypeScript, Go, and more into workflows, internal UIs, and scheduled jobs.

items.title: Argo Workflows (⭐16k)
items.description: Container-native workflow engine designed for orchestrating parallel jobs in Kubernetes-based, cloud-native environments.

items.title: Dagster (⭐15k)
items.description: Data orchestrator with a declarative, asset-based programming model for building and observing data pipelines.

items.title: Activiti (⭐10k)
items.description: Lightweight, Java-centric BPMN engine that efficiently executes business workflows with a focus on simplicity.

items.title: Flowable (⭐9.4k)
items.description: Compact, efficient set of open-source engines for automating and scaling enterprise workflows.

items.title: Cadence (⭐9.4k)
items.description: Fault-tolerant, stateful platform that reliably orchestrates long-running workflows and complex applications.

items.title: Elsa Core (⭐7.8k)
items.description: .NET Core library that integrates seamlessly into any application to execute and manage workflows.

items.title: StackStorm (⭐6.5k)
items.description: Robust automation engine that combines sensors, triggers, and workflows to orchestrate complex IT processes.

items.title: Inngest (⭐5.7k)
items.description: Event-driven durable execution platform that runs reliable step functions inside your existing services.

items.title: Azkaban (⭐4.5k)
items.description: Distributed scheduler that simplifies managing job dependencies in large-scale data processing environments.

items.title: Restate (⭐4.2k)
items.description: Durable execution engine for building resilient workflows, event-driven services, and stateful handlers as plain code.

items.title: Camunda (⭐4.2k)
items.description: Process orchestration platform built on the horizontally scalable Zeebe engine, with full BPMN and DMN support.

items.title: jBPM (⭐1.7k)
items.description: Comprehensive toolkit for automating business processes and decisions with robust workflow management capabilities.

items.title: LittleHorse (⭐392)
items.description: High-throughput, low-latency microservice orchestration engine built on Kafka Streams, with SDKs in multiple languages.

items.description: Open-source BPMN engine with a designer interface to build and automate complex business processes.

items.description: Integration patterns provide standardized solutions for common integration problems within an enterprise. Enterprise Integration Patterns (EIP) provide a common language for describing integration problems and solutions, while Integration Architecture Patterns address high-level concerns of enterprise architects. Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) patterns provide guidance for designing and implementing service-oriented architectures, ensuring that services are scalable, reusable, and loosely coupled.
items.title: Integration Patterns

items.description: Design patterns used to connect systems and applications in an efficient and seamless manner.

items.title: API-led Connectivity pattern
items.description: Use APIs to connect different systems and applications.

items.title: Anti Corruption Layer Pattern
items.description: Add a layer to isolate and transform data between systems.

items.title: Change Data Capture Pattern
items.description: Capture and propagate changes made to a database or data source in real-time.

items.title: Hybrid API Management pattern
items.description: Manage APIs that span both cloud and on-premises environments using a central control plane.

items.title: Hybrid Integration pattern
items.description: Integrate systems and applications that are deployed both on-premises and in the cloud using a combination of integration technologies.

items.title: Integration Architecture Patterns

items.description: Some useful specifications, standards, articles and documentation.
items.title: Resources
OpenAPI (ex.Swagger) (⭐31k)
items.description: A language-agnostic specification for creating RESTful APIs that enables both humans and machines to understand the capabilities of a service without the need for source code or documentation.

items.title: GraphQL (⭐14k)
items.description: A sophisticated query language and runtime for building efficient APIs that empowers engineers to retrieve data from existing systems with ease.

items.title: API Blueprint (⭐8.6k)
items.description: A powerful high-level language for designing and documenting APIs that allows software engineers to easily collaborate and create efficient APIs.

items.title: JSON:API (⭐7.7k)
items.description: A standardized specification for building APIs that simplifies the representation of resources, relationships, and metadata, making it easier for software engineers to create efficient APIs.

items.title: CloudEvents (⭐5.8k)
items.description: A specification for describing event data in common formats to provide interoperability across services, platforms and systems.

items.title: TypeSpec (⭐5.8k)
items.description: A highly extensible language for describing API data shapes and protocols, capable of compiling to OpenAPI, JSON Schema, Protobuf, and other formats.

items.title: AsyncAPI (⭐5.2k)
items.description: An essential tool for developing Event-Driven Architectures (EDA) and enables engineers to build a better tooling ecosystem.

items.title: RAML (⭐3.8k)
items.description: A RESTful API Modeling Language that allows software engineers to design and create efficient APIs by modeling resources, endpoints, and interactions.

items.title: Standard Webhooks (⭐1.7k)
items.description: Open source tools and guidelines for sending webhooks easily, securely, and reliably.

items.title: Arazzo Specification (⭐459)
items.description: A standard, programming language-agnostic representation for describing sequences of API calls (workflows) and their dependencies.

items.title: Protocol Buffers (⭐71k)
items.description: A language-neutral and platform-neutral serialization mechanism that is designed to be highly efficient and extensible. It supports rich data types and is widely used in distributed systems, such as gRPC and Apache Kafka.

items.title: FlatBuffers (⭐26k)
items.description: An efficient cross-platform serialization library from Google that allows direct access to serialized data without parsing or unpacking.

items.title: Apache Arrow (⭐17k)
items.description: Language-agnostic columnar in-memory format for fast data interchange, including the Arrow IPC format and Flight RPC for moving data between systems.

items.title: Cap'n Proto (⭐13k)
items.description: An extremely fast data interchange format and RPC system whose zero-copy encoding doubles as both wire format and in-memory representation.

items.title: Apache Thrift (⭐10k)
items.description: A serialization and RPC framework originally developed at Facebook that generates cross-language bindings from a single interface definition file.

items.title: MessagePack (⭐7.4k)
items.description: An efficient binary serialization format that lets you exchange data among multiple languages like JSON, but smaller and faster.

items.title: Apache Fory (⭐4.4k)
items.description: Fast multi-language serialization framework that uses just-in-time compilation and zero-copy techniques, with a cache-friendly row format. Formerly named Apache Fury.

items.title: Apache Avro (⭐3.2k)
items.description: Data serialization system that provides compact, fast, and efficient serialization of structured data. It supports schema evolution, allows for efficient data compression, and is designed to work well with big data processing frameworks.

items.title: YAML (⭐497)
items.description: A human-friendly and easy-to-read data serialization format that is widely used for configuration files and data exchange. It supports rich data types and is compatible with most programming languages.

items.title: JSON
items.description: A lightweight and easy-to-read data format that is widely used for data exchange. It supports a wide range of data types and is compatible with many programming languages.

children.title: NDJSON (⭐843)
children.description: A standard for delimiting JSON objects in stream protocols. It allows for efficient processing of large JSON datasets and is widely used in big data processing.
